explanation: Choose y₁(x)=cos(x) and y₂(x)=sin(x). Their derivatives give A with rows (0,1) and (-1,0), so |det(A)|=1. Since A is invertible, the homogeneous BVP has only the trivial solution and the inhomogeneous BVP has a unique solution. Although 'has at most one solution' is also true, 'has a unique solution' gives the stronger, complete classification.
